verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://appwrite.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with agent-directed content ('Use Appwrite when a coding agent is writing an app...'). A second probe confirms docs.md is served and points to a documentation-level llms.txt with the full nested page index. First-party docs add Markdown access to every page via a '.md' suffix, a Copy page button, and agent Skills Markdown files that give agents SDK-accurate context.
